It reports percentages for teacher background (age, gender, experience), perceptions and practices related to teaching for today’s world (e.g., adaptation to cultural diversity, special education needs, social and emotional learning), technology use (including reported AI use), and teachers’ learning opportunities (initial teacher education, induction/mentoring, continuous professional learning).
